label: ProductForge-Dashboard Backlog 83
title: Cache controls + hit/miss surfacing (clear cache, bypass/regenerate toggle, per-agent input-cache view)
body:
Dashboard surface for cache correctness (pairs with the backend cache work).
Controls: CLEAR CACHE (per project / per agent); BYPASS / REGENERATE toggle (force fresh generation, i.e. the
backend --no-cache path exposed in the UI); per-agent INPUT-CACHE view showing fingerprint entries + hit/miss
counts from agent-audit-log.json (cache_hit) so the user sees what the input fingerprint matched WITHOUT
exposing stale outputs. Read-only over the backend input-fingerprint ledger; actions routed through the
backend cache owner module.
